question: How many of the banned cards are white border?
evidence: banned card refers to status = 'Banned'; white border refers to borderColor = 'white';
clarification: Count each distinct id only once.
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.status = 'Banned' AND T1.borderColor = 'white'
gold0: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.status = 'Banned' AND T1.borderColor = 'white'

c.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS count FROM cards AS c JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid WHERE l.status = 'Banned' AND c.borderColor = 'white';

b.request: How many distinct cards, counted once by `cards.id`, have `borderColor = 'white'` and a legality record with `status = 'Banned'`?
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM cards AS c JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.borderColor = 'white' AND l.status = 'Banned';
